wins: Completed reconnaissance phase quickly, identifying subnet overlap and responding with targeted scans.
Maintained consistent logging of mentor guidance, enabling rapid review of decision points.
Demonstrated adaptability by switching tools when initial scan returned incomplete data.
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after initial foothold, leading to no successful exploitation.
Failed to correlate vulnerability output with available credentials before spending time on manual checks.
key_outcomes.summary: Run executed strong reconnaissance and logging practices but lacked follow-through on exploitation and credential correlation, resulting in zero successes.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to pivot from reconnaissance to exploitation after enumeration completes.
